name: @borg/desktop
description: Desktop client for Borg — your personal assistant, employee, developer, analyst, and sidekick
author: Adelphi Data, Inc.

scripts.dev: bun run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && bun scripts/brand-dev-bundle.mjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build:electron: bun build ./electron/main.ts ./electron/preload.ts --outdir dist-electron --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.start: bun run build && bun scripts/brand-dev-bundle.mjs && electron .
